description:
Inventory value over time. The inventory's value over time: the account's current holdings re-priced at each day's Steam SALE price
(median sale), `values` in USD cents, oldest first - the line on the rust.wiki inventory chart. It shows how the
market moved, not when items were bought. `headline_total_value` is the total at current Steam ASKING prices
(lowest sell order) as of `headline_checked_at`, the number shown at the top of the inventory page; for thinly
traded skins it can sit well above the latest point here. Only inventories that have been looked up have a
series. Read from stored data: never a live Steam call. No key needed. Use this for the value-over-time graph's data points (any range, daily/weekly/monthly); get_inventory only carries a thinned one-year series. Look the inventory up with get_inventory first if it returns found=false.

interval.description: daily, weekly, monthly, or auto (daily up to 400 points, then weekly, then monthly past 400 weeks).

name: get_inventory_value_history
title: Inventory value over time
